_meta.source: Route structures from MOE, ITE and polytechnic progression information. No named individual appears in this file.
_meta.notes: Two kinds of card, rendered differently on purpose. A profile is a real named person with a link. A typical path is a pattern built from how the system works, labelled as a pattern and never as a person. The profiles array is deliberately empty: no real profile could be verified when this was built, and inventing someone is not a substitute. See OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.

typicalPaths.label: The long climb
typicalPaths.body: Starts at ITE with results that felt like bad news at sixteen. Every step is a real qualification. GPA 2.5 to apply to poly, guaranteed at 3.5.
typicalPaths.takes: About eight years to a degree, paid work available throughout.
typicalPaths.whatMattered: Knowing the guarantee existed early enough to aim at it.

typicalPaths.label: Straight into the field
typicalPaths.body: Picks a field at seventeen and spends three years in it. Leaves with a portfolio and an internship on the record.
typicalPaths.takes: Three years to a qualification and a first job.
typicalPaths.whatMattered: Choosing a course they wanted over the one with the highest cut off they could reach.

typicalPaths.label: The extra year
typicalPaths.body: Comes up short at the end of Sec 4, takes a fifth year at a harder level, and goes on with more open than before.
typicalPaths.takes: One extra year, invisible within a decade.
typicalPaths.whatMattered: Treating the year as a run up, not a punishment.

typicalPaths.label: The switch
typicalPaths.body: Trains in one thing and moves into something unrelated in their forties. From 40 that is directly funded: a $4,000 credit, an allowance while studying, and up to 90 percent off a diploma.
typicalPaths.takes: One to three years to retrain, mid career.
typicalPaths.whatMattered: Having kept learning, so the switch was a step and not a leap.

typicalPaths.label: Admitted on what they made
typicalPaths.body: Results were ordinary. The portfolio was not. Arts admission and Early Admissions both turn on evidence of what you have done.
typicalPaths.whatMattered: Starting to make things at thirteen, before anyone said it counted.

typicalPaths.label: The route people picture
typicalPaths.body: The one most familiar to parents. Good for people who like argument and going deep on a few subjects.
typicalPaths.takes: Two years, then three or four more.
typicalPaths.whatMattered: Liking how JC actually works, rather than choosing it because it sounded correct.
